description: Source code implementing device prioritization web configuration APIs, including base64 decoding, msgpack unpacking, subdoc version management, scheduler processing, and QoS rule validation.

methods.name: get_base64_decodedbuffer
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string into a buffer, returning success or failure.

methods.name: get_msgpack_unpack_status
methods.description: Unpacks a msgpack buffer and returns the unpacking status.

methods.name: getBlobVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version number of a subdocument from syscfg.

methods.name: setBlobVersion
methods.description: Sets the version number of a subdocument in syscfg.

methods.name: webConfigFrameworkInit
methods.description: Initializes supported subdocs and registers them with version get/set callbacks.

methods.name: process_DCPC_WebConfigRequest
methods.description: Processes a web configuration request, validating QoS rules and starting/stopping scheduler accordingly.

methods.name: freeResources_scheduler_doc
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a scheduler document.

methods.name: validateQosRule
methods.description: Validates a QoS rule string for correct MAC, DSCP, and action fields.

methods.name: CheckMacHasValidCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a MAC address string has valid hexadecimal characters and format.

methods.name: Validate_Mac
methods.description: Validates the format and content of a MAC address string.

methods.name: validateAction
methods.description: Validates if an action string is one of the accepted values.

methods.name: validateDSCP
methods.description: Validates if a DSCP value is within the valid range (0-63).
